name: @test-cabinet/voxel-runtime
description: Vendored, prebuilt copy of @test-cabinet/voxel-runtime — the framework-agnostic voxel rig posing/clip playback core plus its three.js binding — so this reference implementation installs and builds with a plain `npm ci` outside the monorepo. Byte-for-byte the library's compiled output (the type-only `@test-cabinet/run-record` rig-contract import, erased at build, is inlined in contract.d.ts); the game loads each entity's rig.json + meshes/*.glb through its public API (`parseGlb`, `poseRig`, `sampleAnimation`) and `/three` binding (`buildPartGeometry`, `VoxelRig`) exactly as a real run does.
